subject: Congrats on series c!!
text:
Hey [NAME],
Congrats on the $150M, that's a huge milestone.
We work with AgTech R&D teams like Carbon Robotics and Aigen where the
challenge is making sure models are actually learning the edge cases that
domain experts already know to look for such as early disease signals,
ripeness variation, unusual growth patterns.
Given you're expanding into new fruit types and scaling farms, I think
there's a timely conversation.
Worth 15 minutes? Also heading to CVPR in Denver in June if that's easier.

subject: [NAME] - AIHA chat
text:
Hi [NAME],

       Thanks again for your interest in our AI After Hours events in the past - I wanted to reach out and properly introduce myself. 

       I'd love to grab a quick virtual coffee to share more about future events we have in place in SF and learn a bit more about how 
       [COMPANY] is thinking about data and ML workflows. My team at Encord work closely with vision AI teams dealing with complex, multimodal data to scale annotation, HITL QA, and model iteration without slowing teams down.

       Would you be open to a 20-min next week for a brief chat? Happy to work around your schedule.

subject: Micha - radiology chat /
text:

subject: Coffee @ISC West [YEAR]?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about SAFR's facial recognition system from Milestone
(we work closely with Ed & Fulgencio there). Reaching out since I saw SAFR
is exhibiting at ISC West [YEAR] - thought it would be a good time to connect.

Bit of context on Encord: We work with Milestone Systems, LiveView
Technologies, Flock Safety, Rhombus, etc. to improve the quality of
computer vision models. We help by consolidating video data curation,
annotation and model evaluation into one platform, with the objective of
accelerating speed to market for new physical security products.

Would you be open to a coffee with our leadership @ISC West [YEAR]? Our US
Director, [SENDER] will be there Wednesday (4/2) to Friday (4/4).
Alternatively, If virtual works better can work around your schedule!

subject: enterprise multimodal eval stack
text:
Hi [NAME],  

 We're hosting a 30-min session with Cohere on next Thursday (July 16) on the infrastructure behind benchmarking//eval. Thought this might be relevant. 

 We'll cover where automated evals break down, what robust eval pipelines look like, and common scaling pitfalls for human and agent feedback.  

 Feel free to register 
here if you'd like to join live. Or sign up to receive the recording afterward.
